onset.Description: Event onset measured from the beginning of the run

Levels.mi_start: Cue period before motor imagery, lasting 2 seconds
Levels.mi_l2r: Motor imagery of horizontal movement from left to right, 10 s
Levels.mi_t2b: Motor imagery of vertical movement from top to bottom, 10 s
Levels.mi_ul2lr: Motor imagery of diagonal movement from upper left to lower right, 10 s
Levels.mi_ur2ll: Motor imagery of diagonal movement from upper right to lower left, 10 s
Levels.unknown: Event was present in source annotations but was not mapped
